plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — confirmed cancellation from a later retention page refreshes pagination

scope.scenario: Create 201 ordered retention requests, paginate from 100 to 200 rows, confirm cancellation on page two, verify the view resets to the first page, then fetch page two again using the fresh cursor.
assertions: The refreshed page contains exactly the first 100 ordered requests.
A fresh next-page cursor is available after cancellation.
Fetching the next page again shows the cancelled row with the cancelled status.
The two-page result has no duplicate request IDs.
No browser page errors or extra mutations occur.
